scope: Actual PREGRASP execution feedback window with owner/probe cancel-release confirmation; not full PICK completion, continuous visibility, ROI or 300-second observer acceptance

motion_window.source: Probe first EXECUTING_FIRST_MTC_STAGE feedback through first FIRST_STAGE_HOLD_CONFIRMED feedback
motion_window.acceptance: Execution feedback interval, not full PICK operation

method.source_interval: Adjacent received header stamps; not direct acquisition history
method.receive_interval: Adjacent receive_monotonic_ns; >250ms uses strict integer comparison
method.motion_boundary: Interior gaps use samples received within feedback window; boundary silence and intersecting gaps reported separately; probe floating-second receive timestamps rounded to nearest ns
method.health_age: latest observed /clock minus data.capture_stamp; same epoch/capture steady age is not acquisition latency
method.incomplete: Owned SIGINT exit130 means INCOMPLETE; no 300s sampling PASS
method.stereo_budget: 250ms counts descriptive only, configured stereo budget null
